description_en: Exports a list of data sources
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public export-data-sources --project-id 10000 --name test --data-source-type rds --sub-type mysql --env-type 1 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExportDataSources

parameters.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the data sources belong. You can call the [ListProjects](~~178393~~) operation to query the ID of the workspace.
parameters.description_zh: 目标数据源所在的DataWorks工作空间ID。您可以调用[ListProjects](~~178393~~)接口获取工作空间ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the data sources belong. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html operation to query the ID of the workspace
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据源所在的DataWorks工作空间ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description_en: The keyword contained in the names of the data sources that you want to export. You can specify only one keyword. For example, if you set this parameter to test, you can call the ExportDataSources operation to export all data sources whose names contain test in the workspace.
parameters.description_zh:
待导出的目标数据源名称所包含的关键字。
当前仅支持配置一个关键字。例如，该参数配置为test（即待导出的目标数据源名称所包含的关键字为test），则调用ExportDataSources接口会导出目标工作空间中所有名称包含test的数据源。

parameters.description_en:

*   odps
*   mysql
*   rds

*   sqlserver
*   polardb
*   oracle
*   mongodb
*   emr
*   postgresql
*   analyticdb_for_mysql
*   hybriddb_for_postgresql
*   holo

parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.description_en:
The subtype of the data source. This parameter takes effect only when the DataSourceType parameter is set to rds.

If the value of the DataSourceType parameter is rds, the value of this parameter can be mysql, sqlserver, or postgresql.
parameters.description_zh:
目标数据源的子类型。仅当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数生效。

当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数可以配置为mysql、sqlserver或postgresql。
